structured.answer: I wouldn't buy anything yet. The page says the cheapest way is an account at פסגות and the fund אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125 (5112628), leaving 86,045 ₪ from 70,000 ₪ after 10 years in its example. But that rests on a "7%" it calls only an example, and the minus sign next to that fund scared me, so I'll ask my son or the bank first.

stuck.why: Not sure whether the 7% is a promise or a guess, and the whole 86,045 depends on it
A minus sign on the fund the page picked; looks like it lost money, which made me back away
The task gave no amount, so I left the page's 10,000 and 500 and didn't touch the sliders
Long and busy with many numbers; I don't know which line counts for me
